title: EmbSIM scenario
description: Timed inputs and assertions for a headless or interactive run of a project (SPEC-007 §2).

target.description: A component, a board, BOARD.PERIPHERAL, COMPONENT.MEMBER for a member of a composite (a keypad's key), `world` for one of the room's fields or `world.BODY` for one of its bodies (ADR-026).

value.description: A world body's spec is an object ({shape?, at, size}); null undeclares a world field or removes a body.

matches.description: Serial text: a pattern (literals, ., [classes], \d \s \w, * + ?, ^ $, one ( ) group), matched at its last place; its group as a number meets equals, min/max or equals_output within tolerance.

equals_output.description: With matches: a part's numeric output (COMPONENT.OUTPUT) read at the same instant.

measure.description: Time-weighted sample-and-hold measurement over a completed, nonempty between window. Numeric min/max/equals expectations only. Duty cycle requires a digital probe with no X/Z intervals.

rtos.description: The firmware's FreeRTOS tasks, sampled each millisecond of the run through the image's symbols (issue #96).

board.description: The board whose MCU runs the kernel; without it, the first with an MCU.

stack_free_min.description: Bytes every task's stack keeps free at its deepest (the 0xA5 high-water mark).

blocked_max.description: The longest any task may stay blocked (a delay, a queue, a semaphore, a notification), sampled each millisecond.

ignore.description: Tasks blocked_max leaves out: those that wait for ever by design.

forbid.description: Codes no diagnostic may have: exact (mcu.clock_gated) or a prefix ending in * (mcu.*).

forbid_severity.description: Fails on any diagnostic of this severity or worse that allow does not name.

allow.description: Codes forbid_severity lets through, exact or by prefix.

require.description: Codes at least one diagnostic must have, exact or by prefix.
